name: Filesystem
note: Writes remain denied even when the server exposes write tools. Use a prepared local installation; runtime package downloads are denied.

name: Local Git
note: Repository changes and remote network access are denied. Grant the prepared Python environment separately as runtime.

name: Memory
profile: Store memory in a selected directory
note: Set MEMORY_FILE_PATH to a file inside the selected storage directory. This profile intentionally permits writes there.

name: GitHub
profile: Read GitHub with a restricted token
note: Use the maintained native binary with its --read-only option and a provider-side read-only token. An egress hostname rule alone does not limit GitHub operations; proxy support must be verified.

name: Brave Search
note: Select stdio transport. Search queries leave your machine; verify the prepared runtime uses the enforced HTTP proxy.

name: Context7
note: Only the listed API hostname is granted. Additional endpoints require explicit review; verify proxy support before calling this profile ready.

name: Slack
profile: Read and post in a Slack workspace
note: The upstream npm package is deprecated but matches the tested compatibility fixture; Slack's hosted remote MCP endpoint cannot be process-sandboxed. Both hostnames are needed: web UI + API.

name: Notion
profile: Search and read Notion pages through the API
note: Single-host API egress. Create NOTION_API_KEY from a Notion integration; the token's page access decides what the server can see.
